name: Frontier Instruments
notes: Radar contacts stay aligned with local space so the dish no longer spins when you turn. The mint chevron is still your nose; the lock ring and flight-mode chip are unchanged.
Market commodities and the Galaxy Best export row plot a jump to the highest legal payout on your charts.
Galaxy dots tint to faction colors; the side panel shows Friendly, Hostile, Contested, or Lawless.
Solace keeps Nellby-9; other stations get a seeded concierge name.
Buy price stays above sell on plotted trade hops.
